mechanism: Etanercept (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases risk of autoimmune phenomena including drug-induced lupus and agranulocytosis, which are also serious adverse effects of propylthiouracil, creating additive myelosuppression and autoimmune risks.
action: Use combination only if benefits outweigh risks; monitor CBC closely for agranulocytosis, and consider alternative thyroid agents (methimazole or levothyroxine) if possible.
